'''Zag Tefilous''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] professional [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] racer.

==Biography==
Zag was born in a family of vagabonds and thrill seekers and left his homeworld along with his sister [[Patra Tefilous|Patra]] at a young age to race in the amateur circuits. His natural skills soon attracted the attention of [[XySpeeder Corp]]oration, and Zag gained his first sponsor. He then went on to compete in the professional circuits and started racing daily, living a life of speed and excitement.
